notes: Engagement: Like, Save (with your own collections) and Follow buttons for posts, authors and categories, and view counts.
Settings → Engagement switches each feature off site-wide, and chooses where buttons appear automatically.
The visitors' dashboard has My saved collections and a Following feed that refreshes itself when a followed author publishes.
Dashboard → Analytics: views, likes, saves and follows per period, top content and most-followed authors.
Views count once per browser per item every 30 minutes, never for the author, and store no IP address or visitor id.
Shop → Backup: export orders, products, reports, customers, coupons, reviews, offers, questions, price alerts, bundles and settings to a ZIP (with optional spreadsheet copies), and import it back.
Import chooses per part: update & add, add missing only, replace, or add as copies (products and coupons), with a preview of every change before anything is written.
Product likes, saves (wishlists) and view counts.
Product Q&A: customers ask, the store answers under Shop → Questions.
Make an Offer: accept, decline or counter under Shop → Offers; an accepted offer becomes a single-use coupon.
Price-drop alerts, emailed from Shop → Price alerts.
Frequently Bought Together with an optional bundle discount, set under Shop → Bundles and applied at checkout.
New shortcodes [rwp_product_qa], [rwp_make_offer], [rwp_price_alert], [rwp_frequently_bought] and matching Page Builder widgets.
New Engagement Bar and Popular Content widgets.
